title: Optional additional cost 'you may discard 1' and the 'deal 5 instead' rider are missing
expected: Card data at /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json:549-568 (ven-008-166 Ruthless Strike) has "abilities": [null] despite rulesText declaring "As an additional cost to play this, you may discard 1 ... If you paid the additional cost, deal 5 to it instead." No TS card override exists (grep for ven-008-166/ruthless-strike finds only the JSON). play-spell.ts:262-263 and :1220 gate the paidAdditionalCost variant on getOptionalPlayCost(cardId) (cost.ts:780-896), which reads registry abilities and needs an additional-cost-option ability; ran a harness scenario and got getGlobalCardRegistry().getAbilities("ven-008-166") -> [] and getOptionalPlayCost -> undefined, so no paid variant is enumerated and forcing paidAdditionalCost fails the condition. Discard option and deal-5 rider are indeed missing.
observed: Only one playSpell variant enumerated (no paidAdditionalCost); no discard prompt on play; forcing paidAdditionalCost:true (with/without discardIds) via REST returns CONDITION_FAILED. Parsed abilities for ven-008-166 in the card registry contain only {type:'spell', timing:'action', effect:{type:'damage', amount:3, target unit@battlefield}} — no additional-cost-option ability and no if-paid conditional (set JSON has abilities:[null], re-parse from rulesText drops the cost clause).

history.note: ven-008-166: replaced abilities:[null] with the optional discard-1 additional-cost static + paid-additional-cost conditional damage 5/3
